title: lobelia appendiculata var. gattingeri
intro: Lobelia appendiculata var. gattingeri, commonly known as a plant species, is a variant of Lobelia appendiculata. It is a plant known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lobelia appendiculata var. gattingeri include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including expectoration and anti-inflammatory effects.
